subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Matching headings, vocabulary development and Time to Talk / Workbook practice: skimming a Fact File and multiple choice
outcomes: Match headings to paragraphs by finding each topic sentence
Find and use new words such as merchants, exported and gigantic
Skim texts and answer multiple-choice questions with good strategies

tf.s: A topic sentence gives the main idea of a paragraph.
tf.why: Yes, it tells you what the paragraph is about.

tf.s: The topic sentence is always the last sentence of a paragraph.
tf.why: It is usually, but not always, the first sentence.

tf.s: Paragraph 2 of the text is about the Arabs as traders.
tf.why: Correct, that is the main idea of paragraph 2.

tf.s: 'Merchants' are people who buy and sell goods.
Frankincense was exported to Greece, Italy and Egypt.
tf.why: Yes, it was sent to these countries to be sold.

tf.s: Oman became a member of the WTO on 9 November 2000.
tf.why: Correct, the Fact File gives this date.

tf.s: Pictures and sub-headings are not useful before you read.
tf.why: They help you get the gist and see how ideas are organised.

tf.s: When skimming, you must read every word slowly.
tf.why: Skimming means reading quickly for the general idea.

tf.s: 'That's a fair deal' is a phrase you can use when you agree to a trade.
tf.why: Yes, it shows you accept the exchange.

boxes.q: What does a topic sentence give?
o: the main idea of a paragraph
boxes.why: It states what the paragraph is about.

boxes.q: Which word means 'people who buy and sell goods'?
Which word means 'sent to another country to be sold'?
Which word means 'ways from one place to another'?
boxes.why: Trade routes are the paths traders used.
The WTO deals with rules of trade between countries.

boxes.q: What do you shade in a multiple-choice answer sheet?
boxes.why: You shade the bubble of the correct answer.

o: What will you give me for my...?
boxes.why: You ask what your partner will offer.

boxes.q: How many words may you write for each answer in Activity 1?
boxes.why: Keep answers to three words or fewer.

boxes.q: Which part of speech helps with 'people who buy and sell goods'?
boxes.why: 'People' tells you to look for a plural noun.

hunt.q: People who buy and sell goods

mcq.q: Where is the topic sentence usually found?
o: at the start of the paragraph
in the last line of the text
mcq.why: It is usually, but not always, the first sentence.

mcq.q: What does the World Trade Organisation deal with?
o: the rules of trade between countries
mcq.why: The WTO deals with trade rules.

mcq.q: When did Oman become a member of the WTO?
Which word means 'connected with trade, industry and money'?
mcq.why: Economic relates to money and trade.

mcq.q: Complete: Frankincense was ___ to Greece, Italy and Egypt.
mcq.why: Frankincense was sent out of Arabia to be sold.

mcq.q: Complete: 'The goods that are traded have changed ___.'
mcq.why: An adverb describes how they changed.

mcq.q: You want to swap your pen for your partner's book. What do you say?
o: What will you give me for my pen?
That's because my pen is blue.

mcq.q: Why should you read the whole text before answering multiple-choice items?
o: to get the gist so it is easier to reject wrong answers
because the answers are in the title
so you can skip the questions
mcq.why: Knowing the gist helps you reject three answers.

mcq.q: Why is heading c best for the Farooq Al Sumar text?
o: it relates to what the whole text is about
it uses the most difficult words
mcq.why: The best heading covers the whole text, not one detail.

mcq.q: 'Trade has changed the course of history.' Why is this a good first sentence?
o: it states the main idea of the paragraph
mcq.why: It is the topic sentence of paragraph 1.
